description: The first contract (design doc §15): take the data off Cold Storage's server and walk it back to the fixer. How you get in, and what you leave behind, is priced at turn-in rather than forbidden.
title: Cold Storage
text: A client wants what is on the server in the back room of the cold store on the east lot. Three ways in that we know of: the front door takes a staff token, the fire stair reaches a maintenance window, and the service tunnel runs under the slab from a street grate. Get the data, get out of the lot with it, and bring it here. Quiet pays double.

objectives.description: Leave the site carrying the data
